name: glass-lens
title: Glass lens
description: A glass ball moves over the picture and refracts what is behind it.

props.name: src
props.doc: Picture in public/ (used when no children are given).

props.name: radius
props.doc: Radius of the lens in pixels.

props.name: path
props.doc: Where the lens is: [frame, x, y] keys, x and y as fractions of the frame width and height. It eases (slow in, slow out) between keys, so a key is a rest; two close keys make a hold with a little drift.

props.name: ior
props.doc: Index of refraction of the glass. 1.5 is crown glass; higher bends more.

props.name: depth
props.doc: How thick the lens is, as a share of its radius. More depth is more magnification.

props.name: dispersion
props.doc: How far the colours split at the edge (0 for none).

props.name: rim
props.doc: Strength of the bright rim and highlight.

props.name: shadow
props.doc: Darkness of the lens's shadow on the picture.

props.name: push
props.doc: How far the picture pushes in over the shot.
